title: Ledger
description: Where each paragraph of a divided document went (docs/adr/0040-a-document-is-divided-among-specs-and-every-paragraph-has-a-place.md): a list of allotments, each a destination and the blocks of the extraction that go there. It is the owner's, and SCE counts it: which paragraphs went nowhere, which were both used and left out, and which went to several specs are SCE's counts, and the form has no field in which a ledger could say it is complete. One allotment to a destination, and parts left out for different reasons are different allotments; the tools write them in a fixed order. The extraction it is of is named by its revision, the SHA-256 of its canonical text.

reason.description: Why a part was left out. Asked for, and allowed to be empty: leaving a part out is an act, and an empty reason is still that act. Only what is left out has one.

blocks.description: At least one block, each once, in the extraction's order (which a schema cannot say and the tools check).

oneOf.description: A spec that exists, by the id the specs folder gave it.
A spec to be made when the division is confirmed, by the title the owner gave it.
Out of the document, on purpose.
